manifest_row.title: Covid-19 stimulus is climate's 'Last Chance Saloon'

screening.main_topic: Using Covid-19 economic stimulus in New Zealand and globally to reduce emissions and invest in climate-friendly infrastructure.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is the article’s central subject: it discusses the urgency of emissions reductions and argues that stimulus spending can accelerate decarbonisation, renewable energy, public transport, and other climate-related measures.
screening.reason: The article substantially examines climate policy and green investment in response to the pandemic, including views from New Zealand’s climate change minister and Greenpeace representatives. The donation and comments material at the end is ancillary.
